title: Not sure if anyone remembers MythMaster from the early 90s - I'm making a little game inspired by that.
author: NaryaNZ
selftext:
This is to a much lower standard than the other games I've seen people talking about in here - I know it's very basic stuff but I'm an absolute beginner at using AI and I'm not a programmer. 

I've hosted it at \[www.narya.co.nz\](http://www.narya.co.nz) .

The "quest" is very short at the moment, my kids have been my test players and they've been more interested in things like "why can't I jump off the cliff" and "why doesn't it know the verbs kick/punch etc" (the answers to both being "this isn't that sort of game..." and "there's only so many destructive impulses I can predict...").

Please let me know if you find bugs, or have suggestions for me.
